accessibility.evidence: Motion does not alter focus, links or dialog controls. Simulated prefers-reduced-motion JS preference disables all active parallax panels, yields transform none, and zero running gallery animations; CSS reduced-motion fallback is also present.

responsive.evidence: 1440px full-width highlight is 777.59px high; 390px highlight is 265.2px high with limited 80px overscan. Image covers frame at measured positions and neither viewport overflows.

loading.evidence: Viewer reports Loading photograph on opening before image load.

empty.reason: All eight fixed albums have 10 to 64 existing photographs; no dynamic empty collection.

partial.evidence: Curated selections and lazy thumbnail strip preserve all 305 original image links; full-resolution assets load only when opened.

error.evidence: Dispatched image error shows recovery text and original-image link; advancing chooses the next photograph.

success.evidence: Measured local image transform advances 100px for 200px scroll, matching reference 0.5 speed. Every album includes motion script; original image counts retained. No missing local assets.

permission.reason: Public static images require no account or permission.

renderedEvidence.observation: Full-width parallax highlight separates the aligned image rows with clean clipping and no blank edges.
Edge-to-edge image fits mobile width, with a limited crop and white spacing before subsequent pictures.
